builds_on: crypto PR #5261 (study bwd-20261126/v1, research/binary-weil-descent-20261126, arm D), stacked on PR #5253 (bcr-20261126/v1, A1 + A2)
single_target: every solve is one cold solve of one public Q; no multi-target amortisation (owner instruction)
seed_derivation: unchanged #5253 seeds.rs: seed(parts) = first 8 bytes big-endian of SHA-256('bcr-20261126/v1|' + '|'.join(parts)); stream = SplitMix64(seed). The prefix stays bcr-20261126/v1 so that curves, targets and relation-target streams are bitwise those of #5253/#5261.

selftest and engineering (separate insta: bdsl-selftest-curve | bdsl-selftest-target | bdsl-selftest | bdsl-selftest-stream | bdsl-selftest-la | bdsl-wcal-curve | bdsl-wcal

custody: d drawn from the 'target' stream inside the evaluator; the solver receives (curve, G, Q, ell); [d]G = Q checked inside the counted solve; d == d_true compared by the evaluator after the solve

arms.DS: arm D's relation phase unchanged (#5261 descent.rs, A1 stream, group-law resolution) + stopping rule (2-core excess >= 1 at a checkpoint) + SGE (singletons, weight-bounded Markowitz pivots by cross-multiplication, cost-model stop) + excess pruning to <= 2 + Wiedemann mod ell (sparse projection, Berlekamp-Massey, k-1 dense random rows); bdsl_harness (this study)
arms.DSB_l1.41, DSB_l2: DS with the factor base reduced to the classes whose keyed hash is below 2^64/lambda, lambda = sqrt(2) and 2 (declared here, before data); the oracle is unchanged and its decompositions are filtered to the reduced base (one hash probe per point, counted); the stop rule and LA scale with the reduced base
arms.D: #5261 arm D (echelon LA), records reused unchanged from research/binary-weil-descent-20261126/data/runs_d.jsonl
arms.RHO: #5253 negation-map rho, 16 seeds per target; panel: #5253 data/runs.jsonl; n = 36..48: #5261 data/runs_ext_ref.jsonl; n = 51, 54: new, the #5253 binary unchanged (sha256 bf3f431f...4d52d4011b)

reference_binary_sha256: bf3f431fcec5a4e724e7282c952d3f1c90f2daf51789f2a20e931a4d52d4011b (#5253 bcr_harness rebuilt here; equals #5253's recorded A2 binary)

stop_rule.condition: 2-core excess >= 1, then the LA; if the LA returns no d, continue to the next checkpoint and rerun the LA from scratch (counted)
stop_rule.F: factor-base classes excluding T (reduced base for DSB)

rungs.rho_lanes: same W as n = 51 (no n = 54 pilot: host budget)

rho_lanes_choice: n <= 48: the lanes of the reused records (#5253 panel, #5261 W = 64); n = 51: argmin of mean Meq(s=1,u=1) over W in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64} on 2 held-out pilot curves x 16 pilot targets (#5253 'pilot' command, unchanged); n = 54: the n = 51 choice

resources.rule: a killed/failed process is a resource-limit record, never a negative result; the run continues with the next rung

primary_metric: Meq(s=1,u=1) of the whole cold solve (factor base, setup, target stream, oracle, relation replay, LA including every LA rerun, [d]G = Q); #5253 unit unchanged
cost_unit_mod_ell: one product mod ell = one z, one addition mod ell = one za, each priced u Meq (u in {0, 0.1, 1}; primary u = 1, i.e. one F_{2^n} multiplication); an inversion mod ell = 2*bits(ell) z; a product with an operand equal to +-1 is a sign change and is not charged (#5253 kernel() rule; the echelon of D pays for its products because its pivot rows are normalised); index bookkeeping is not charged (as for D's echelon). Sensitivity readings: meq_s1_u1_pm1_charged (+-1 products charged as z) and meq_s1_u1_pm1_and_structural_charged (also every counted bookkeeping operation at 1).
band: u in {0, 0.1, 1} for non-field units, s in {1, 0.25} (AGENTS.md 5a); an order between arms is stated only where it holds across the band; the two sensitivity readings are reported next to it
analysis: bdsl_harness analyze: paired per-case DS/rho, D/rho, DSB/rho (rho = mean of 16 runs on the same Q), DS/D, DSB/DS; per-rung geometric mean with hierarchical bootstrap B = 10000 (2000 for band and diagnostics); rho A/A (seeds 0-7 vs 8-15); DS relation-phase/rho, DS LA/rho, DS rel/D rel, DS LA/D LA; shadow identity; DS census; exponent fits; crossover model

checks.logs: [d]G = Q in-solve and d == d_true, every solve
checks.shadow_identity: n <= 48: an uncounted copy of #5253's echelon is fed DS's rows exactly as D feeds it; at its stop, (d, targets, relations, columns) and the 7 relation-phase counter maps must equal #5261's D record of the same case bitwise
checks.relations_prefix: DS relations >= D relations on every case with a D record
checks.kernel_cross_check: n <= 30: the SGE+Wiedemann dependency is tracked back to the input rows (uncounted) and checked exactly: sum c_j row_j = 0 and sum c_j (a_j + b_j d) = 0, with d equal to the shadow echelon's d
checks.replay: n = 39, ci = 0, ti = 0 rerun from the frozen manifest; every non-wall field compared bitwise

hypotheses.H1: every DS and DSB log correct; shadow identity on every case n <= 48; DS relations >= D relations everywhere; every kernel cross-check exact
hypotheses.H2: LA_DS / F^2 (mod-ell units, u = 1) in [0.4, 1.5] at every rung n >= 36, with an exponent of LA_DS in F of 1.8-2.2
hypotheses.H4: DS/rho in [12, 40] at n = 48; within 15% of D/rho for n <= 33; no parity at any rung (upper 95% bound of DS/rho > 1 everywhere)
hypotheses.H5: DS LA share at n = 48 in [0.3, 0.7]; DS relation phase / D relation phase in [1.0, 1.03] at every rung
hypotheses.H6: model: with LA = c F^2, no crossover for the full base; the relation phase alone crosses near n' ~ 23-25; the balanced-base minimum ratio is 10-40x, no crossing
hypotheses.H7: DSB_l1.41/DS < 1 at n >= 48 and > 1 at n = 42; DSB_l2/DS > DSB_l1.41/DS at every rung n <= 48

predictions.la_model: LA_DS ~ 3 * rho_r^2 * w * F^2 + 4 (rho_r F)^2, rho_r = remainder rows / F ~ 0.12, w = remainder row weight ~ 13 (entries mostly +-1, so ~1 charged op each): ~0.6-0.8 F^2

falsifier: parity at a rung if the upper 95% bound of DS/rho <= 1 there; such a rung then requires the rho A/A floor and the full verification before it is stated
exclusions: none; every record, failure, kill and rerun is retained
untested: block Wiedemann with block size > 1 / block Lanczos (block size 1 used: see PROTOCOL.md, deviation declared before data)
D (echelon) at n = 51, 54 (wall: about 2 h per case)
